items.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin to hold first three-way summit
items.summary: The three leaders will meet in China on the sidelines of the APEC summit. The White House says Trump plans to discuss the Iran war and nuclear arms.

items.headline: US envoy Kushner aims to bring Europe and Russia into Ukraine talks
items.summary: Jared Kushner said both Kyiv and Moscow know compromises will be needed, and that he is working on direct talks between Europe and Russia as the next step.

items.headline: UN says 25 seafarers killed around Hormuz since the war began
items.summary: The UN counted 25 seafarers killed in and around the Strait of Hormuz since the US-Israel war on Iran started.

items.headline: Anthropic's share sale is about six times oversubscribed
items.summary: Anthropic expects to set its final share price on 18 November, with trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT from the next day.

items.headline: Poundland stores to get 16m new grocery items
items.summary: The struggling discount chain's owner has released funds to restock its shops while rescue talks continue.

items.headline: CrowdStrike buys two AI-agent security start-ups
items.summary: The cyber security firm is reported to be paying about $495m in total. It also added an emergency 'kill switch' that lets security staff stop a rogue AI agent.
items.source: TIKR and AI Agent Store, 14 Nov

items.headline: Nvidia approaches Arm boss Rene Haas to be its next CEO
items.summary: After Jensen Huang's resignation, Nvidia's board says it will search inside and outside the company for a permanent successor.
items.source: AI news roundup on note.com, 14 Nov

items.headline: OpenAI disbands its robotics team
items.summary: OpenAI says general-purpose AI models can now run robots, so it no longer needs a separate robotics team.

items.headline: Cloudflare open-sources a web browser built for AI agents
items.summary: Kitesurf is a lightweight browser engine that AI agents can use instead of a full copy of Chrome.
